summary: The compliance review of the Kirana Credit product, specifically its Inventory Loans for Shopkeepers feature, identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The primary issues include non-compliance with DLD2025:12(ii) regarding the lack of granular consent options and the inability to revoke or delete data. Additionally, there are medium-level non-compliance issues with DLD2025:13(i) on data storage beyond minimal requirements and DLD2025:12(iii) on the disclosure of the purpose of data collection. The review also noted repeated high-level non-compliance with DLD2025:12(iv), which overlaps with DLD2025:12(ii). These findings highlight the need for immediate improvements in data consent management and transparency.
